invariants.name: draw_calls_observed_on_encode
invariants.note: A painted UI+HostTexture frame must issue at least one real draw. Missing stays not-evaluable.

invariants.name: gpu_upload_bytes_observed_on_encode
invariants.note: Count only after a host encodes/submits. Missing stays not-evaluable and must never be treated as 0.

notes: NanaUI-internal GPU scale row; not Issue #8 DoD and has no Iced/GPUI analog. 64 distinct host textures, one node each. Without TEXTURE_BINDING_ARRAY (the product device requests Features::empty()) one draw per distinct texture is the honest floor; this row records that floor and the per-node bind-group and buffer cost around it.
